atoms.b: Animals eat fruit because it is ((++juicy disgusting)).
After eating the fruit, the animals will ((++move_to_a_new_location stay_in_the_same_place)).
The seeds will either be carried in their fur or left in excrement in this new location. This prevents ((++overcrowding the_area_looking_ugly)).

hint.text: Excrement is a more scientific way of saying poo.
hint.label: Excrement

atoms.b: The seeds will remain intact, allowing a new plant to ((++grow die)).
((++Birds Dogs)) play a large role in seed dispersal because they can fly to new locations, dispersing the seeds wherever they go.
Ants and other small insects also disperse seeds. Ants grip food with their mouths and take it back to their ((++nest house)).

instruction.text: Select the plant that needs animals to disperse its seeds.

trainers.hint: Which plant has a juicy fruit that animals might want to eat?

instruction.text: Put the stages of seed dispersal into the correct order, with the first step at the top. You can select each image to hear a description.

atoms.sound: the animal moves to a different location
the seed is left in the animal’s excrement
the seed becomes buried by the soil and a new plant grows
